# gramlot-examples 0.3.43

- Requires gramlot 0.3.35: typst is no longer a standard collection, and the Typst lesson declares it in `gramlots` (Python and JavaScript). With gramlot 0.3.35 or later, gramlot-examples 0.3.42 cannot build the Typst lesson.
- The gallery build no longer copies the unused typst artifact (41 MB) into `gallery/dist`.
- Parity tests build each page with the collections it declares; the page server and the test import map read the collection files from `collectionAssets()`.
